amendments_before_first_score.new_threshold_introduced: YES -- NULL_SIGNAL_RATIO = 0.5. Declared openly because the usual rule for amending a frozen bar is that no new threshold may be added. That rule governs edits made AFTER results exist; here none do.
amendments_before_first_score.outcome_neutrality: TRIVIALLY SATISFIED AND STATED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: no head has been scored on this arm, so there is no measured verdict that this amendment could move. A bar may be corrected before its first use; after it, this same edit would be a post-hoc change and would not be permissible.
amendments_before_first_score.revert_pre_commitment: if the permuted-test-label null is later shown to be insensitive to a fault the shuffled-training-label null would have caught, this amendment is reverted and the arm is re-scored, not re-interpreted.
amendments_before_first_score.what: replaced the inherited shuffled-TRAINING-label null with a permuted-TEST-label null, and declared the scoring definition and sign handling
amendments_before_first_score.why: the inherited null is INFORMATIVE AT 1,280 FEATURES AND VACUOUS AT ONE. This arm's primary is one feature, so the inherited gate would have returned INDETERMINATE_NULL_FAIL after a 4.64 h run for a reason that has nothing to do with the heads. The scoring definition was simply absent, and the two candidates differ on whether the arm is zero-shot at all.

criterion: ceiling: best achievable prediction of bacterial promoter activity from sequence, reported against the replicate-derived 0.941 ceiling

forecast.my_forecast_record_in_this_project: 5 of 9. Do not defer to this prior; it is recorded so the bar can be scored on it.
forecast.reasoning: these heads were fitted on different libraries at 86 bp and are applied here with no fitting on this substrate at all, while the incumbent is a ridge FITTED on this rung. A zero-shot predictor losing to a fitted one is the expected direction.

honest_limits_fixed_in_advance: ZERO-SHOT TRANSFER, not head quality: all five heads were trained on other libraries, so a null bounds transfer to the GSE144621 tile rung and says nothing about the heads as predictors of the libraries they were fitted on.
GEOMETRY MISMATCH: the heads expect 86 positions and the substrate is 150, so every number here is a windowed application and not a native one. 65 windows per tile.

THE tslpred-kosuri2013 HEAD'S ENDPOINT DOES NOT MATCH THIS RUNG. It predicts TRANSLATION; promoter activity is a transcription quantity. It is included under the standing instruction to leave no stones unturned, and its inclusion WIDENS every head's interval via the alpha/5 correction rather than helping the arm.

CIRCULARITY IS SCOPED, NOT ABSENT: the urtecho2018 head is circular on the sigma70 rung (GSE108535) and must never be a comparator there. It is not circular on this substrate, and that scoping is recorded so nobody carries it to the wrong rung.

THE INCUMBENT IS A FITTED RIDGE AND THIS ARM IS NOT FITTED AT ALL. The comparison is therefore asymmetric in tuning budget, and it is asymmetric AGAINST this arm. A loss bounds the pair, not the heads alone.
0.941 IS THE REPLICATE CEILING, so the incumbent 0.5076 is 54%% of what is achievable. An arm that ties the incumbent has not approached the ceiling.

margin.derivation: INHERITED verbatim from the tile-chain rung's incumbent bar; not re-chosen for this arm, because a per-arm margin is a free parameter

metric_rule: the arm's metric is max over the 5 declared heads of the median Spearman at the mean reduction; never over a ladder, never across arms

multiplicity.divisor_moved_from_four_to_five: an earlier note recorded four heads; five were measured. The correction is therefore alpha/5, which makes the arm HARDER to pass than alpha/4 -- the honest direction for an inherited miscount.
multiplicity.why_not_heads_times_reductions: the arm's metric is the MAXIMUM OVER HEADS at the primary reduction only. Correcting over heads x reductions would be ten comparisons wearing the costume of five, and would also make the ineligible secondary count toward the verdict.

pre_commitments: a sub-margin gain returns HEADS_TIES, decided here and NOT re-readable as a win
the max reduction is reported but is NOT eligible as the arm's result
the arm's metric is the max over heads at the primary reduction ONLY
a null bounds TRANSFER to this rung, NOT the heads
the route is per_window_recompute and is NOT to be switched after seeing a score
a collapsed head yields INDETERMINATE_COLLAPSED_HEAD, never a scored null
the arm is scored by DIRECT Spearman with the sign as given; the ridge form is reported but is NOT eligible as the arm's result
the null is PREDICTOR-side-valid (fixed predictor, permuted test labels) and must satisfy BOTH its median and its magnitude condition
question: do the five shipped expression heads, applied zero-shot, beat the frozen encoder's median Spearman 0.5076 by the inherited margin 0.02 on byte-identical splits?

reductions.why: one primary per head. The max-over-windows reduction is declared now so it can be reported without being promotable: on the positional arm the highest-scoring rung was an ineligible secondary, and having said so in advance is the only reason that result could not be re-read as a win.

scoring.comparability_note: the incumbent 0.5076 comes from ridge_spearman, which fits on log1p(expression) and scores Spearman against RAW expression. This arm fits nothing, so only the SCORING half applies: Spearman against RAW expression, identically.
scoring.formula: spearman(head_output[test], y[test]) with the sign AS GIVEN
scoring.why_the_ridge_form_is_ineligible: a one-feature ridge fits the SIGN from the training labels, so the arm would borrow supervision from this substrate and stop being zero-shot -- which is the claim its own name makes. Reported beside the primary, never as it.

validity_controls.geometry: every head's fc1 must be (64, 11008) and the window count must be 65
validity_controls.head_validity: each head must produce finite, NON-CONSTANT output across the cohort. A collapsed head would score as a clean null rather than as a fault, which is the failure mode that most resembles a finding.

permutation_null.condition_magnitude: max|null| < 0.50 x |real median Spearman| -- this is the condition that catches a null which cannot destroy the signal it is meant to destroy
permutation_null.form: FIXED predictor, PERMUTED TEST labels, NO refit: spearman(head_output[test], permute(y[test])) over the seed set.
permutation_null.measured_replacement: the permuted-test-label null measured |median| 0.0015, max|null| 0.0371 against a real 0.8772 -- noise-sized, and consistent with the 1/sqrt(n_test) ~ 0.032 sampling scale a permutation Spearman has by construction
permutation_null.why_not_the_inherited_shuffled_TRAINING_: The sibling arms shuffle TRAINING labels and refit, which works because their primaries are 1,280-feature matrices that a shuffled fit genuinely destroys. This arm's primary is ONE feature, where StandardScaler + Ridge can only scale and SIGN-FLIP, so shuffling the training labels cannot destroy the ranking -- only its sign. MEASURED: every such null returns +/-0.8814 against a real 0.8814, i.e. the arm's entire signal with a random sign, so the gate either FAILS for a reason unrelated to the heads or PASSES by sign cancellation. Neither is a control. The 128-feature case measured 0.01-0.12 (median 0.0088) on the same data, which is why the sibling arms were unaffected.

validity_controls.split_equality: the test sets must match the committed n_test_per_seed exactly

windowing.tolerance_derivation: DERIVED FROM THE MARGIN, not from these numbers. Gains on this rung sit in the 0.00-0.05 band against a margin of 0.02; two predictors agreeing at rho ~0.99 can differ in Spearman-against-labels by order 0.01, half the margin. Requiring 0.999 holds route-induced movement near 5% of the margin.
windowing.why: head promoteratlas-tslpred-kosuri2013 agrees with the faithful route at only 0.9888, below the margin-derived tolerance 0.9990, so the cheap route is NOT allowed to define the arm. The arm pays 4.64 h instead of 0.24 h. The cheap route is probably fine -- but 'probably fine' is not a frozen bar, and a 19.3x saving does not justify an unquantified risk to the verdict.
windowing.why_the_true_route_is_the_faithful_one: a head is a function from an 86-position latent to a scalar, so handing it 86-position latents is what APPLYING the head means. The cheap route feeds it a pooled representation computed with context the head never saw at training time, which is an approximation introduced for speed and nothing else.

zero_shot_framing: These heads were trained on OTHER libraries (hossain2020, lafleur2022, urtecho2018, yu2021, kosuri2013). This arm therefore measures TRANSFER to the GSE144621 tile rung. A null result bounds that transfer; it does NOT bound the heads.
